test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

He said to his brother, "Where did you go for a picnic?"

options.text: He asked his brother where he had gone for a picnic.
He asked his brother where did you go for a picnic.
He asked his brother where did he go for a picnic.
He asked his brother where he went for a picnic.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. '**He asked his brother where he had gone for a picnic**.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech **'**said to**'** will be changed into **'asked'** because it is an interrogative sentence.
 
• Now let's change the reported speech and we have to convert the interrogative sentence into an assertive sentence.
 
• **'You'** will be changed into **'he.'**
 
• Here, **'**did you go**'** is in simple past tense and will be changed into past perfect i.e., 'he had gone**.'**
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is: 'He asked his brother where he had gone for a picnic.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__* He asked his brother where he had gone for a picnic.*
